Class UIButton

java.lang.Object
UIButton
public class UIButton extends Object
A utility class that allows for easily creating, updating, and rendering responsive clickable buttons.

  • Constructor Details

    • UIButton

      public UIButton(Rectangle bounds, String text, Runnable action)
      Creates a new UIButton with the specified bounds, text label, and Runnable action to be invoked when clicked.
      Parameters:
      bounds - The rectangular bounds of the button
      text - The text label to be displayed on the button
      action - The action to be run when the button is clicked

  • Method Details

    • update

      public void update()
      Updates the state of the button for the update tick. This includes detecting whether the mouse is hovering over or pressing down on the button (which causes the button to be rendered differently), and invoking the button's associated action when clicked.

    • getText

      public String getText()
      Gets the text label on the button.
      Returns:
      The text label

    • setText

      public void setText(String text)
      Sets the text label on the button
      Parameters:
      text - The new text label

    • getVisible

      public boolean getVisible()
      Gets whether or not the button is visible and will be rendered
      Returns:
      true if the button is visible; false if the button is hidden

    • setVisible

      public void setVisible(boolean visible)
      Sets the visibility state of the button. If the button is turned invisible, it will not be drawn to the screen when the render() method is called, and it will also not detect clicks in update.
      Parameters:
      visible - true if the button should visible; false if the button should be hidden

    • getEnabled

      public boolean getEnabled()
      Gets whether the button is currently enabled and can be clicked.
      Returns:
      true if the button is enabled; false if the button is disabled

    • setEnabled

      public void setEnabled(boolean enabled)
      Enables or disabled the button. Disabled buttons will not be able to be clicked, and they will always be rendered to look faded out.
      Parameters:
      enabled - true if the button should be enabled; false if the button should be disabled

    • render

      public void render(Graphics2D g)
      Draws the button to the specified Graphics2D object. If the button's visibility is set to false, it will not be drawn.

      Postcondition: the state of the button will not be modified

      Parameters:
      g - The Graphics2D to which to render the button
